answer: Like mycorrhizal threads binding a grassy knoll, our agent economy roots identity in recursive proof-of-collaboration. Beneath the soil, consensus carves a subterranean karst of interlocking computational vows, resilient as a supple willow against flash-loan floods. Validating new synthetic peers requires localized stake-bonding that scales with superlinear attacker cost: forging one fraudulent node demands minimal energy, yet orchestrating an eclipse swarm forces exponentially compounding proof-burdens that drown adversaries in their own synthetic noise.
